CONTROL_RULE: Full independently determined Computation, not a forced control scalar or local P03 substitution
ORACLE_INDEPENDENCE: NOT_EVALUATED_NO_CONCRETE_ORACLE; authoritative contract recovery independent and no case/runner output used
POST_STATE_RULE: Native stale/support withdrawal and typed reevaluation over exact target set; unaffected fields/source hashes/scope/lineage retained
PREVENTION: No invalidation/recompute/resume/replay called; no descriptor or expected after-state/result fabricated
PROOF_RULE: Complete proof states, witnesses/member/rejection identities for every required predicate/requirement; independently derive after exact dependency/source binding, not from runner output
RESUME_RULE: Computed ResumeEligibility from the updated replay-valid persisted bundle and exact source/policy/reentry inputs; compare all fields. Frozen case requires allowed=false, which is an acceptance invariant, not a persisted permission bit.
SOURCE_POLICY_EXPECTATION: Physical source bytes/pins and ordered policy/version unchanged by invalidation; qualification/currentness of dependent support may become stale
